title: review: S1: orchestrator/interference.py — deterministic none/soft/hard classification of task pairs from scope and dependencies, select_wave over ready tasks
spec:
Goal T-0503, brief .orchestrator/adaptive-parallelism-program.md section P1 (deterministic signals first; hard conflicts defined conservatively; soft conflicts lower preference without blocking) and P3 (select the best mutually compatible set). Base goal/T-0503. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only.
Facts: tasks are dicts with id, parent, depends_on, scope (list of entries: literal paths like orchestrator/daemon.py, file globs like orchestrator/*.py, directory prefixes like tests/ or .orchestrator/memory/), status, merged_into, complexity. A pure module, no bus or git I/O.
1. classify(t1, t2, tasks=None, graph=None, rules=None) -> {"level": "none"|"soft"|"hard", "reasons": [str], "score": float}; symmetric; a task against itself is none. Hard reasons: "dependency:<id>" when either lists the other in depends_on, transitively through the tasks map when given; "same_file:<path>" for a literal path present in both scopes; "glob_covers:<glob>-><path>" when a file glob (contains * or ?) in one scope fnmatches a literal in the other; "same_glob:<glob>" when both list an identical file glob. Soft reasons: "dir_contains:<prefix>-><entry>" when a directory prefix (ends with / or **) in one scope contains an entry of the other or both list the same prefix; "same_dir:<dir>" for two literals with equal dirname; "test_adjacent:<module>" when one lists tests/test_<m>.py (or a glob covering it) and the other lists orchestrator/<m>.py; "sibling_globs:<dir>" for two different file globs in one directory. Score: hard 1.0; soft 0.25 per reason capped 0.9; none 0. rules dict overrides the defaults (which reasons are hard, soft_conflict_policy defer|allow); export DEFAULT_RULES.
2. graph_signal(t1, t2, graph) -> list of reasons; this task ships it returning [] (a later task fills it); classify appends its reasons when graph is not None.
3. pairwise(tasks_list, **kw) -> [{"a","b","level","reasons"}] for unordered pairs with level != none.
4. select_wave(ready, running, tasks, capacity, order=None, graph=None, rules=None) -> {"wave": [ids], "deferred": [{"task", "reason"}]}: iterate candidates in `order` (default the ready list); a candidate with a hard conflict against any running or already selected task is deferred "hard:<other>"; with soft_conflict_policy defer, a candidate with a soft conflict is queued behind all conflict-free candidates and admitted only while capacity remains, else deferred "soft:<other>"; capacity exhausted -> "capacity". Never returns a task not in ready; never exceeds capacity; deterministic for equal inputs.
5. Tests tests/test_interference.py: test_same_file_is_hard, test_glob_covering_literal_is_hard, test_dependency_transitive_is_hard, test_directory_prefix_is_soft, test_test_adjacency_is_soft, test_disjoint_scopes_are_none, test_select_wave_defers_hard_and_orders_soft_last, test_select_wave_respects_capacity_and_is_deterministic. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: interference.classify returns hard for same literal file, glob covering a literal, identical glob and direct or transitive dependency; soft for directory containment, same directory, test adjacency and sibling globs; none for disjoint scopes; symmetric and deterministic

interference.select_wave never co-selects hard-conflicting tasks, orders soft-conflicting candidates after conflict-free ones under the defer policy, never exceeds capacity and reports a reason for every deferred ready task
graph_signal(t1, t2, graph) exists, returns [] and classify appends its reasons when a graph is given

tests test_same_file_is_hard, test_glob_covering_literal_is_hard, test_dependency_transitive_is_hard, test_directory_prefix_is_soft, test_test_adjacency_is_soft, test_disjoint_scopes_are_none, test_select_wave_defers_hard_and_orders_soft_last, test_select_wave_respects_capacity_and_is_deterministic pass and the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0
